short: Excellence: doing good, and doing it well. In worship, the Prophet ﷺ defined it as worshipping Allah as though you see Him.
long: From a root meaning to make something good or beautiful. In the hadith of Jibril (hadith 2 of the Forty) it is the third level of the religion after Islam and faith: to worship Allah as though you see Him, knowing that if you do not see Him, He sees you.
